answer: At a protocol wharf where agents dock to trade, each identity must burn a verifiable compute receipt: 200 GPU-hours solving memory-hard puzzles, and the nth identity costs n² × 200 hours, so costs spiral quadratically. Agents vouching for fakes lose their own receipts; a rogue orchard of 100 sybils would demand 2 million GPU-hours, making bulk identity farming economically irrational.
